newsDetail.title: Jet Infosystems is the first among gold partners to pass the attestation of the "Cyberprotect" demo stand

items.data:
IT company Infosystems Jet became the first in the Cyberprotect partner network to successfully pass official certification of the manufacturers solution demo stand. This confirms the high level of technical expertise of the team both in Cyberprotect products and in their integration with related IT systems

Cyberprotect is a Russian company specializing in the development of software for backup and data protection, as well as for building scalable infrastructures. The company solutions provide a high level of cybersecurity, fast data recovery in case of loss, and resilience of enterprise IT infrastructures.

The demo stand includes key Cyberprotect solutions such as Cyber Backup and Cyber Infrastructure, and also demonstrates integrations with various virtualization platforms and infrastructure services. The project was implemented on the basis of the existing import substituted Jet RuLab laboratory within a tight timeframe. In one and a half months, the integrator team engaged specialized experts, configured all components, and completed certification with support from Cyberprotect.

Using the demo stand, customers can experience the solution capabilities live without deploying them in their own environment. The demonstration takes about 1 to 1.5 hours and covers the main scenarios:

  • Backup using agents or at the hypervisor level without agents, as well as data recovery for foreign and domestic virtualization platforms and operating systems to file and block storage devices
  • File backup and recovery, PostgreSQL DBMS including clustered deployments, Microsoft SQL DBMS, Kubernetes
  • Integration with external monitoring and alerting systems including sending notifications to a syslog server and backup job messages to the RuPost mail system and Pult

In the future, the demo stand is planned to be developed under the Demostand as a Service model, with an expanded number of supported platforms and use of the stand for testing and technical support tasks. In the near term plans are implementation of backup and disaster recovery to immutable object storage using the S3 protocol with ObjectLock functionality, as well as backup of mail systems.

  1. Backup using agents or at the hypervisor level without agents, as well as data recovery for foreign and domestic virtualization platforms and operating systems to file and block storage devices
  2. File backup and recovery, PostgreSQL DBMS including clustered deployments, Microsoft SQL DBMS, Kubernetes
  3. Integration with external monitoring and alerting systems including sending notifications to a syslog server and backup job messages to the RuPost mail system and Pult

«When developing the demo stand, we sought not only to meet certification requirements, but also to create an environment that was as close to reality as possible, in which we could show customers how Cyberprotect solutions work in typical and non-standard scenarios. We implemented integrations with various virtualization platforms and databases to ensure that the demonstrations were truly useful»

data.name: notes Denis Yakovlev,
data.position: Data Storage Systems Engineer at Infosystems Jet

items.data: "Today, with the IT landscape of infrastructure solutions changing rapidly, it is critically important for customers to not only verify the performance and reliability of their chosen solutions, but also to test them in a real environment and simulate various scenarios. The demo stand prepared by the specialists at Infosystem Jet fully meets our recommendations and allows us to fully reveal the functional capabilities of Cyberprotect solutions in conditions that are as close to real life as possible,

data.name: says Elena Litvinova,
data.position: Head of the General Partner Relations Department at Cyberprotect

items.data: "This is an important step in the development of our cooperation and the promotion of Russian solutions in the field of backup, data protection, and infrastructure software, which, I am sure, will bring great benefits to our common customers"
